sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.255 of 2023 registered at Police Station - University, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
Allegation against the present applicant is that he got gold loan sanctioned by depositing 8 karat gold.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The bank had followed all the guidelines prescribed for sanctioning gold loan and thereafter sanctioned loan on 03.7.2023.

Before sanctioning the loan, gold was checked and inventory cum appraisal certificate has also been prepared, therefore, allegation against the present applicant - accused that he deposited fake gold is prima facie false.

The gold which was sealed can Burhan Juber vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61184908/
1 only be opened in the presence of the borrower, however, the bank opened the seal in the absence of the applicant and re- examined the gold.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further argued that applicant is in custody since 06.7.2023.
He is the permanent resident of District Gwalior (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion o r tampering with the prosecution evidence.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Burhan Juber vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61184908/
